Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Giftbox
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center]Give the beginning of your Stardew Valley adventure a Pokémon twist!
[/center]
[center]This mod replaces the [b]Parsnip Seeds package[/b] that [b]Mayor Lewis[/b] gives you at the start of a new game with a Pokémon-themed design, making your very first gift fit perfectly into a Pokémon-inspired playthrough.
[/center]
[center]The mod only changes the appearance of the item and does not affect gameplay or the contents of the gift.

[/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/0ryTJqxk/features.png[/img]
[/center]
[center]Replaces the starter gift received from Mayor Lewis with a Pokémon-themed design.[/center]

[center]Keeps the original item and functionality unchanged[/center]
[center]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6[/center]
[center]Lightweight and easy to install
[/center]
[center]This mod is part of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098][b]Pokémon Eggventure[/b] project[/url], but it can also be used as a standalone visual enhancement.[/center]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Pokemon Eggventure - GiftBox
Manifest.Description: Changes the giftbox into a pokeball giftbox.
Manifest.Author: Parme69
